subject: Sanitize module logging: DEBUG logs (#810)
reason: The change only sanitizes DEBUG-level log message text: it wraps user-controlled strings in vmsdk::config::RedactIfNeeded(), an inline helper that returns either the unchanged string_view or the constant '*redacted*' based on the pre-existing search.hide-user-data-from-log config, and moves one NOTICE log line behind absl::call_once so it prints once per FLUSHDB instead of unconditionally. No command reply, RDB/AOF format, replication, indexing, or query behavior changes — only server-log text at DEBUG level, which no fuzzer oracle (reply comparison, ledger, deployment state, liveness) can obs
